newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-SoundView ups IBM target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-SoundView ups IBM target.

text.p: SoundView Financial analyst Gary Helmig said he raised his price target on International Business Machines Corp to $200, from $180, on a pre-split basis, or $100 on a post-split basis, from $90.
-- Helmig said he believes IBM's stock could reach his target in the third quarter.
-- Helmig said the second quarter is looking "very strong" and that he is "very comfortable" with his earnings estimates of $2.85 a share, pre-split, for the second quarter.
-- "They (IBM) are executing on this transition to lower-margin businesses," Helmig said. IBM was up 2 to 91-5/8.

-- Helmig said IBM's hard disk drive business is performing well, PCs were continuing at a strong pace in April and May, and that his estimate of 23 percent revenue growth in its computer services business "might be conservative."

-- Helmig also said that the weaker dollar, especially against the Japanese yen in recent weeks is helping IBM and the computer giant is "less exposed" this quarter to a negative impact from currency fluctuations.
-- IBM's shares began trading on a post-split basis Wednesday, after a two-for-one stock split went into effect.
